description:
Update single Accident Log.

#### See - [Daily Log guide](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/daily-logs) - for additional info on
* Attachments

rejection_reason.description: Reason given when the log was rejected. Null when no reason was given or the log is not rejected.

rejected_by.description: User who rejected the log. Null when the log is not rejected.

id.description: ID of the user who rejected the log.

name.description: Name of the user who rejected the log.

company.description: The rejecting user's company (vendor) in the project company's directory. Null when the user has no vendor.

rejected_at.description: Timestamp when the log was rejected. Null when the log is not rejected.

id.description: Unique identifier for the accident log.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the accident log was created.

involved_name.description: Name of the person involved in the accident

involved_company.description: Name of the Company involved in the accident

position.description: Order in which this entry was recorded for the day

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the accident log was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the accident log was deleted; null if it has not been deleted.

status.description: Approval state of the accident log.

created_by_collaborator.description: Whether the accident log was created by a collaborator.

id.description: ID of the user who created the accident log.

login.description: Email address of the user who created the accident log.

name.description: Name of the user who created the accident log.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this vendor/company.

name.description: Display name of the vendor or contractor company.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last update to Location

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the segment was soft deleted

deleted.description: Indicates if the segment is deleted

data_type.description: Data type of the Custom Field Definition

value.description: The value of the custom field

variant.description: The variant of the Custom Field Definition (e.g. `phone_number`). Present only when the definition has an associated variant.

400.description: Can not update due to errors

403.description: User does not have right permissions

409.description: Conflict. A rejection reason was sent for a log that is already rejected, and either the log already has a reason or a non-null reason was sent.

date.description: Date that the accident occurred. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

datetime.description: Datetime of record. Mutually exclusive with the date property.

involved_company.description: Name of the Company involved in the accident

involved_name.description: Name of the person involved in the accident

vendor_id.description: ID of the Vendor associated to the accident

location_id.description: The ID of the Location of the Accident Log.

attachments.description: Accident Log Attachments. To upload attachments you must upload the entire payload as `multipart/form-data` content-type and specify each parameter as form-data together with `attachments[]` as files.
